abstract: OBJECTIVE: To outline the geographical distribution pattern of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) in a referral center in Bahia, Brazil, and determine the demographics of the disease. STUDY DESIGN: We conducted a study of data retrieved from medical records of 140 GTD patients referred to our Trophoblastic Diseases Center in 2002-2007, assessing geographical distribution across health care districts, demographics, referral sources, and previous pregnancy status. RESULTS: The most common GTD types were hydatidiform mole (106, 75.7%), invasive mole (32, 22.9%), choriocarcinoma (1, 0.7%), and placental site trophoblastic tumor (1, 0.7%). GTD incidence was 8.5 in 1,000 deliveries. Most patients originated from the coastal region (East district), which includes the state capital (77.9%). The 20-34 age group predominated (65%). Education level (67.9% attended elementary school only) and employment rate (42.9%) were low. Secondary hospitals were the principal source of referral (84.3%), followed by self-referrals (15.7%). Regarding previous pregnancy status, 42.1% (n = 59) had had term pregnancy, 39.3% (n = 55) no pregnancy, 15% (n = 21) miscarriage, and 0.7% (n = 1) ectopic pregnancy; 4 patients (2.9%) had previous hydatidiform mole. CONCLUSION: GTD predominated in the peak fertility age group and among patients of unfavorable sociodemographic status.
abstract_ja: 目的：ブラジル・バイーア州の紹介センターにおける妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の地理的分布パターンを明らかにし、本疾患の人口統計学的特徴を調べること。研究デザイン：2002〜2007年に当トロホブラスト疾患センターに紹介された140例のGTD患者の診療録データを後方視的に調査し、保健医療地区ごとの地理的分布、人口統計学的特徴、紹介元、既往妊娠の状況を評価した。結果：最も多いGTDの型は、胞状奇胎106例(75.7%)、侵入奇胎32例(22.9%)、絨毛癌1例(0.7%)、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍1例(0.7%)であった。GTDの発生率は分娩1000件あたり8.5であった。患者の多くは州都を含む沿岸地域(東部地区)の出身であった(77.9%)。20〜34歳の年齢層が多かった(65%)。教育水準(67.9%が初等教育のみ)と就労率(42.9%)は低かった。紹介元は二次医療機関が主で(84.3%)、次いで自己紹介(15.7%)であった。既往妊娠の状況は、正期産42.1%(59例)、妊娠歴なし39.3%(55例)、流産15%(21例)、子宮外妊娠0.7%(1例)で、4例(2.9%)は既往に胞状奇胎があった。結論：GTDは妊孕性の高い年齢層や社会経済的に不利な状況の患者に多くみられた。
